|game_text='''Agendas''': order. May be targeted by [[Might Of The Republic]]. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 and gain [Republic] here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with 'Valorum', 'governor' or 'political' in lore.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-03-Supreme_Chancellor_Valorum-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-supremechancellorvalorum-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Supreme_Chancellor_Valorum.png]]) show the original text (see [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Agenda: order. May be targeted by Might Of The Republic. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 (and gain [Republic]) here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with "governor," "political," or "Valorum" in lore.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-supremechancellorvalorum-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Supreme_Chancellor_Valorum.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 15) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “Agenda:” to “Agendas:”, dropped the parentheses (“deploy -1 and gain [Republic] here”) and moved “Valorum” first (“a card with 'Valorum', 'governor' or 'political' in lore”)<ref name="cl-1281_30-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013</ref>: “Agendas: order. May be targeted by Might Of The Republic. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 and gain [Republic] here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with 'Valorum', 'governor' or 'political' in lore.” (The capture of 21 July 2012 prints the ▲ as “/\”; the captures from 12 December 2012 write it out as “take into hand … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, which is notation only.) No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-03-Supreme_Chancellor_Valorum-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
